## English

### Android: in-app APK installation works again

- Fixed `downloadAndInstallApk` failing on every Android version since 10.53.0. The APK downloaded fine, but staging it rejected with `APK_INSTALL_FAILED: Unable to stage APK installation` and the system install screen never appeared. The installer committed the `PackageInstaller` session while the APK write stream was still open, and the system refuses that (`SecurityException: Files still open`) and abandons the session. The stream is now closed before the session is committed.
- Affected versions: 10.53.0 to 10.59.1 (when APK installation moved to `PackageInstaller`). 10.52.x and earlier use the previous install path and are not affected. iOS and HarmonyOS are not affected.
- This is a native change: rebuild the Android app with 10.59.2 and ship it through your store or sideload channel. A JS-only update cannot fix an installed app, so users on an affected build need to install the fixed build once by other means (store, website download, etc.); in-app APK updates work from that build onward.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.59.1...v10.59.2)

## 中文

### Android：应用内 APK 安装恢复可用

- 修复 10.53.0 起 `downloadAndInstallApk` 在所有 Android 版本上都会失败的问题。APK 能正常下载完成，但安装阶段会以 `APK_INSTALL_FAILED: Unable to stage APK installation` 失败，系统安装界面不出现。原因是安装时在 APK 写入流尚未关闭时就提交了 `PackageInstaller` 会话，系统会拒绝提交（`SecurityException: Files still open`）并放弃该会话。现在先关闭写入流，再提交会话。
- 受影响版本：10.53.0 至 10.59.1（APK 安装改用 `PackageInstaller` 之后的版本）。10.52.x 及更早版本用的是旧的安装方式，不受影响。iOS 和鸿蒙不受影响。
- 这是原生改动：需要用 10.59.2 重新构建 Android 应用，并通过应用商店或直装渠道发布。JS 热更新无法修复已安装的应用，所以已经装了受影响版本的用户需要通过其他途径（应用商店、官网下载等）安装一次修复后的版本，此后应用内 APK 更新即可正常使用。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.59.1...v10.59.2)
